description: The next production candidate, combined: the approved fusion ship profile (W2, engine reuse, the op-fusion set) + the prefill SDPA one q chunk per core (K64j-OQ) + the 13x10 matmul grids (switchable; the prefill and drafter sub-switches only, the decode verify sub-switch is held out until an audited attach has compared it) + octo-T8 and its three levers (non-alternating) + the tile-aligned drafter window + the host KV tier with the preconverted checkpoints, as ONE traffic profile under ONE owner traffic waiver (decision PENDING). The tool-call whitespace fix is default on for every profile. Its gate-only twins (the audited twin -s4-audit, the grid-off control -s4-nogrid13) are generated by make_ship4_profiles.py; its gate pack is references/fusion-jobs/ship4 (make_ship4_jobs.py).

ship.name: traffic-s4
ship.reason: the combined production candidate of 2026-10-11: the approved fusion ship profile -fx-traffic plus the prefill SDPA one q chunk per core, the 13x10 matmul grids (QWEN_FAST_GRID13=prefill,drafter: the sub-switches proven exact on cards; the decode verify sub-switch, site verify.out, is held out and lives in the audited twin only), octo-T8 with its three levers (every eligible 8-live round on the octo block), the tile-aligned drafter window, the host KV tier (32 GiB beside the 8 GiB checkpoint store, verify=sample, audit=0) with the preconverted checkpoints, and the third block's memory plan (the KV pool 19,968 to 16,500 blocks, the trace region 512 to 640 MiB). The image bakes the K64j-OQ graft (whose packed-any records have landed). The exactness control is -fx-traffic on the same image
ship.read_note: OCTO READ (tp4/octo-3, the shape and its three levers run under this profile's waiver): python3 scripts/ci/octo_judge.py --container-log <container log> --profile <ship profile> clean, i.e. exactly one '[OCTO] admitted mode=live ... (owner traffic waiver <id>)' line; the six '[OCTO] UNQUALIFIED' lines, which are EXPECTED here (they are the card questions the waiver stands in for: the 'no UNQUALIFIED admission line' of an SR read applies to the 262k evidence waiver, not to them); at least 16 rounds with shape=octo at 8 live and rows=8 and no program compiled on the first octo round; the octo draft engaged once and serving at least half of the octo rounds at 8 live with no fallback or disabled line; the bundled attention engaged once with its call line; the glue8 engaged lines at users=8 rows=8 for every site and no fell-back line; the K/V page writer's 'octo 8-row served path' line once; the TAP window lever's engaged line and no fell-back line. concurrent8_steady is the test that supplies the octo rounds (the skew, stall and drain shapes run below six live seats most of the time). TIER READ (tp4/prefix-tiers on this profile): the host tier's attach lines in the container log ('[PINDIAG] prefix: host tier on', 'host tier IO attached', 'tenant quota' absent: the quotas are not in this profile), 'host tier restore' and 'host tier spill' lines in the tier pair's logs, no 'latched off' or failure line.

waiver.waives: ONE waiver for everything this production candidate carries that has no pinned qualification record, each lever named with what it is outside of. (A) Inherited in full from w2-er-fx-262k-2026-10-11 (the approved fusion ship waiver, docs/tp4-fusion.md): the W2 multi SDPA launch (QWEN_FAST_TP4_SDPA=multi: outside packed_any_evidence_tp4_262144.json) and F1 (QWEN_FAST_TP4_CONV_GATES_SPREAD=1: no record), engine reuse and its drafter-trace book (QWEN_FAST_PARKED_ENGINES, QWEN_FAST_PARKED_DRAFTS: no ballast ladder, kill-switch drill or fault job), and the op-fusion levers (default-off, exact by construction and by audit on cards, no contract mechanism: named as the owner's decision). (B) The octo shape and its three levers, (1) QWEN_FAST_OCTO=live, the third packed block of eight users of eight rows (one 64-row verify pass instead of two M3 passes at eight live seats): its attention is the K64j extent program at flags 0x21 with one eight-row group per bundle (geometry G8B1), which is outside the pinned four-card evidence records (packed_any_evidence_tp4.json and packed_any_evidence_tp4_262144.json cover the served G8B2 programs at flags 0x23 and the multi-user launch is the M3 blocks' own), the batched GDN launch at eight users (96 cores, one wave) has no card-M record, and the serving_octo admission refuses the shape outside a gate run of a gate-only profile (QWEN_C2_GATE=1 with QWEN_C2_GATE_PROFILE=1) - this waiver is the one other way in, named by the profile's own QWEN_FAST_OCTO_WAIVER; (2) QWEN_FAST_OCTO_ATTN_BUNDLE=4, the octo block's attention in two K64j launches of four users per layer (flags 0x21 with B > 1 entries, 16 cores per entry, no kernel or factory change), outside every record; (3) QWEN_FAST_OCTO_GLUE8=1, the GDN split, merge, block conv and packed windows run by quarter-tile data-movement kernels at eight-row users (exact by construction and by the in-trace audit of the audited attach, with no card-M mover harness and no pinned record); (4) QWEN_FAST_OCTO_DRAFT=1, one eight-seat, eight-row draft pass in place of the two quads for an all-eight-live octo round (it can change only how many tokens a round commits (tau: its checkpoint is trained at sixteen rows), never which, and its trace beside engine reuse is not in the draft book: the coordinator rebuilds it after a rebound member); and QWEN_FAST_OCTO_MIN_LIVE=6, the eligibility knob. A record could replace this waiver: the K64j card jobs Q1w, Q1a and Q1b (k64j_card_b.py --kv-heads 1 --octo: G8B1 at flags 0x21 equal to its compile-time twin at every family and start, one trace over more than 50 families, the stale-writer zone and the native one-row decode against the one-entry call) with a bundle arm for B = 4 (not built), Q2 (gdn_tp4_card_test.py --users 8 --rows 8: one launch equal to eight per-user launches bit for bit) and a quarter-tile mover harness (not built), recorded in a new pinned section of the packed-any evidence beside the G8B2 one (not built); until then the owner's decision stands in for them. The op-fusion levers and QWEN_FAST_TAP_WINDOW_ALIGNED this profile also sets are the fusion ship waiver's kind (default-off, exact by construction and by audit, no contract mechanism) and are inherited from w2-er-fx-262k-2026-10-11 and named here as the owner's decision, not as a mechanism. (C) The host KV tier and the preconverted GDN checkpoints (QWEN_PREFIX_HOST_TIER_GIB=32 beside the 8 GiB checkpoint store, QWEN_PREFIX_CKPT_PRECONVERTED=1; docs/prefix-store-hygiene.md): outside any pinned record (the contract, prefix_policy_problems, admits them on a traffic profile only under a waiver naming each at this value, TIER_WAIVABLE_LEVERS); exact on cards on the gate-only audit twins, but the tier has run beside no concurrent decode of other seats, and never beside octo-T8, engine reuse's rebind of a parked engine on a restored turn, or the 16,500-block pool. The per-tenant quotas (QWEN_PREFIX_TENANT_QUOTA_*) are NOT in this profile: the contract refuses them on traffic (no qualification record exists) and the quota isolation gate TQ1 runs them on the audit twin only. (D) The prefill SDPA with one q chunk per core (QWEN_FAST_SDPA_PF_ONEQ=1): default-off, byte-identical to the stock path by the card-M proof and by audit; its binary K64j-OQ differs from the one the older packed-any records were made on and its OWN records have landed (RQ0-RQ2, all PASS), so a traffic boot passes admission; named here as the owner's decision. (E) The matmul grids for the 13x10 grid (QWEN_FAST_GRID13=prefill,drafter, M1): default-off, exact by argument and by audit on cards for the two sub-switches this profile names, the prefill all-gather matmuls and the fused commit's drafter feature projection. The third sub-switch, verify (the 64-row verify block's output projections, site verify.out), is NOT in this profile: its first audited attach (card run 38116769673) stopped at engine start before it compared anything, so it has never been audited exact on a card; it stays in the audited twin -s4-audit, whose next attach exercises and audits it, and adding it to the candidate (QWEN_FAST_GRID13=1) is a later decision after that audit passes. The decode ABAB of the grids (the F2 window) had not reported when this was written, so the line is the one switchable line of this profile: delete it from the ship entry of scripts/ci/fusion-wp/S4.json (and regenerate) if that ABAB or the N1/N2 pair shows a loss. (F) QWEN_FAST_TAP_WINDOW_ALIGNED=1 (tp4/rebind-fast: data movement only, bit-identical, removes a per-prompt-length compile on returning turns) and the tool-call whitespace fix (c2_toolcall_whitespace, a correctness fix, default ON for every profile, not a lever) are named as the owner's decision. Nothing in this list has run on a card TOGETHER: the audited attach A1, the ship gates and the tier pair of references/fusion-jobs/ship4 are the first
